items.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024
items.q: For me the hippest thing going was Branford Marsalis and Sting and Wynton and a bunch of things.

ctx.x: And it’s like where have I been like what did I miss? You know what I mean? In the lineage of the whole thing. So what are they missing now I don’t know. I mean I think — some things I think are the same, like the hippest thing going. For me the hippest thing going was Branford Marsalis and Sting and Wynton and a bunch of things. Now they have this thing going it’s still Brad Mehldau and I don’t know who are the younger cats. I guess the piano player — all these names are going to escape me right now — but…
Is it an issue for you to try to keep up with contemporary media? You’re supposed to be an instructor.
